arxiv-2204-09390.title: Essential spectrum and Feller type properties
arxiv-2204-09390.creator: Ali BenAmor, Batu Güneysu, Peter Stollmann
arxiv-2204-09390.description: Abstract We give necessary and sufficient conditions for a regular semi-Dirichlet form to enjoy a new Feller type property, which we call weak Feller property . Our characterization involves potential theoretic as well as probabilistic aspects and seems to be new even in the symmetric case.

arxiv-2301-09493.title: Functionality of box intersection graphs
arxiv-2301-09493.creator: Clément Dallard, Vadim Lozin, Martin Milanič, Kenny Štorgel, Viktor Zamaraev
arxiv-2301-09493.description: Abstract Functionality is a graph complexity measure that extends a variety of parameters, such as vertex degree, degeneracy, clique-width, or twin-width. In the present paper, we show that functionality is bounded for box intersection graphs in ℝ 1 \mathbb{R}^{1} , i.e. for interval graphs, and unbounded for box intersection graphs in ℝ 3 \mathbb{R}^{3} .

arxiv-2408-06010.title: DEEPTalk: Dynamic Emotion Embedding for Probabilistic Speech-Driven 3D Face Animation
arxiv-2408-06010.creator: Jisoo Kim, Jungbin Cho, Joonho Park, Soonmin Hwang, Da Eun Kim, Geon Kim, Youngjae Yu
arxiv-2408-06010.description: Abstract Speech-driven 3D facial animation has garnered lots of attention thanks to its broad range of applications. Despite recent advancements in achieving realistic lip motion, current methods fail to capture the nuanced emotional undertones conveyed through speech and produce monotonous facial motion. These limitations result in blunt and repetitive facial animations, reducing user engagement and hindering their applicability.

arxiv-2412-08668.title: Heat transport in ionic liquids
arxiv-2412-08668.creator: C. Cockrell 1,2,∗ , A. Dragović 3
arxiv-2412-08668.description: Abstract Heat transfer in liquids is a very challenging problem as it combines the competing effect of high frequency oscillations, which dominate liquid heat capacity, and diffusive motion, which enables mass transport and macroscopic flow. This issue is compounded by the relatively junior state of dynamical theories of liquid thermodynamics.

arxiv-2503-17599.title: Evaluating Clinical Competencies of Large Language Models with a General Practice Benchmark
arxiv-2503-17599.creator: Zheqing Li, Yiying Yang, Jiping Lang, Wenhao Jiang, Junrong Chen, Yuhang Zhao, Shuang Li, Dingqian Wang, Zhu Lin, Xuanna Li, Yuze Tang, Jiexian Qiu, Xiaolin Lu, Hongji Yu, Shuang Chen, Yuhua Bi, Xiaofei Zeng, Yixian Chen, Lin Yao
arxiv-2503-17599.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated considerable potential in general practice. However, existing benchmarks and evaluation frameworks primarily depend on exam-style or simplified question-answer formats, lacking a competency-based structure aligned with the real-world clinical responsibilities encountered in general practice. Consequently, the extent to which LLMs can reliably fulfill the duties of general practitioners (GPs) remains uncertain.

arxiv-2602-12903.description: Abstract We study repeated bilateral trade when the valuations of the sellers and the buyers are contextual. More precisely, the agents’ valuations are given by the inner product of a context vector with two unknown d d -dimensional vectors—one for the buyers and one for the sellers.

pmc-11392947.title: CD36-mediated ferroptosis destabilizes CD4+ T cell homeostasis in acute Stanford type-A aortic dissection
pmc-11392947.creator: Hui Li, Peng-Fei Wang, Wei Luo, Di Fu, Wei-Yun Shen, Yan-Ling Zhang, Shuai Zhao, Ru-Ping Dai
pmc-11392947.description: Acute type A aortic dissection (ATAAD) is a lethal pathological process within the aorta with high mortality and morbidity. T lymphocytes are perturbed and implicated in the clinical outcome of ATAAD, but the exact characteristics of T cell phenotype and its underlying mechanisms in ATAAD remain poorly understood.

pmc-13296234.title: Ulmus pumila Linné (Ulmi) Extract Attenuates Inflammatory Responses in Atopic Dermatitis by Modulating Lipid Peroxidation and Oxidative Stress
pmc-13296234.creator: Min Jung Kim, Mi Jin Jang, Young Zoo You, Ye Jin Yang, Ji Woong Heo, Hee Ho Kim, Hun Hwan Kim, Se Hyo Jeong, Gon Sup Kim, Young Woo Kim, Ju-Hye Yang, Ryounghoon Jeon, Sang-Hyun An, Kwang Il Park
pmc-13296234.description: Background: Atopic dermatitis (AD) is a chronic inflammatory skin disorder characterized by oxidative stress and impaired skin barrier function. These pathological features contribute to persistent inflammation and symptom exacerbation, highlighting the need for therapies that can both reduce oxidative stress and modulate inflammatory pathways.

pmc-13408477.title: Entropy-Based Phonocardiogram Classification Using Continuous and Synchrosqueezed Wavelet Transforms: A Systematic Comparison
pmc-13408477.creator: Anupinder Singh, Vinay Arora, Mandeep Singh
pmc-13408477.description: Background/Objectives: Cardiac auscultation is an important method for identifying cardiovascular abnormalities, but conventional methods are limited by examiner-dependent variability and sensitivity. The automatic classification of phonocardiogram (PCG) has the potential to be applied for standardized cardiac screening, but still has to deal with signal non-stationarity and the extraction of discriminative features.

pmc-13591689.title: Development and validation of a risk models for gout in patients with diabetic kidney disease
pmc-13591689.creator: Ningyu Cai, Mengdie Chen, Yiyun Wang, Ping Feng, Xianping Zhu, Qidong Zheng
pmc-13591689.description: BackgroundPatients with diabetic kidney disease (DKD) exhibit a markedly elevated risk of developing gout. The coexistence of these conditions severely compromises health. Consequently, risk for gout necessitates evaluation within this patient cohort. This study aimed to identify risk factoes of gout among DKD patients and to establish and validate a clinically usable nomogram for estimating individual gout risk.
